skill.summary: Copy and snapshot all important agent context (MEMORY.md, memory/*.md, AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, etc.) into a dedicated archive directory or repo. Use this skill when you want to back up your memories, context, or configuration files in preparation for maintenance, corruption recovery, or transferring to another host.
